results.description:
Caitlyn came to England to find her family, but a visit to an enchanted chocolate shop changes everything. Now she's plunged into a world of magical secrets, chocolate spells, and Old English legends… not to mention discovering that she herself is a witch! Can she learn to master magic and solve a mysterious murder, to unravel her past and finally find her place in the world? If you love enchanted villages, found family, magical baking and slow burn romance… this is the book for you!

Caitlyn's world changes when she learns that she was found as an abandoned baby and adopted by her American family. Now, her search for answers takes her to a tiny English village where a curious death has everyone whispering—and where a mysterious shop selling enchanted chocolates is home to the "local witch"…

Soon Caitlyn finds herself fending off a toothless old vampire, rescuing an adorable kitten and meeting a modern-day Mr Darcy… not to mention discovering that she herself might have magical blood in her veins!

When she's drawn into village secrets and begins to suspect magical foul play, Caitlyn is forced to choose. With danger brewing and magic misbehaving, can she master her newfound witchy powers in time to solve the mystery — and finally find where she belongs?

A cozy fantasy witch mystery set in an enchanted English village with chocolate magic ~ 

"... the perfect blend of magic and mayhem. This series has me completely bewitched!"

Clean read: no graphic violence, sex, or strong language.
This book follows British English spelling and usage.
